verdict.rationale: Ledgy is an equity-management SaaS, and such a product could plausibly embed an AI assistant that consumes external MCP servers, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only a GraphQL API with OAuth service accounts, HRIS integrations and equity workflows. Nothing shows an AI agent or MCP-client capability that can plug in external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
